Send a Kind Message in a Mandala

Put a kind word in the middle of a mandala, then text it, post it or print it for someone who could use it. It takes a couple of minutes, and it's free with no signup.

Draw anywhere in the circle.
Every stroke repeats around the center.

Tip: draw with a mouse, finger or stylus. Use Shapes to add rings of petals, dots and scallops, and Surprise me for a fresh design.

    How to send a kind mandala

    1. Pick a frame. Each starting design opens with a message in the middle. Surprise me makes a new frame and keeps your words.
    2. Write your message. Tap one of the suggestions, or type up to two short lines of your own.
    3. Make it theirs. Pick a line color and a background they'd like, and serif or sans serif lettering.
    4. Send it. On a phone, Share sends the picture and a link by text, WhatsApp or any app. Or save a square picture for a post, or a story for Instagram.

    Ideas for kind messages

    • To lift someone up: You've got this. Proud of you. Keep going. You are enough.
    • When things are hard: Thinking of you. Sending love. Here for you. Get well soon.
    • To say thanks: Thank you. Grateful for you. You made my day.
    • To celebrate: Happy birthday. Congratulations. Best day ever.
    • For calm: Breathe. One day at a time. Be gentle with yourself.
    • Just because: You matter. Miss you. Glad you exist.

    A name works too: put it on the first line and the message on the second, like Mom and Thank you.

    What they see

    The link opens a page with your mandala and its message, and nothing else to click away to. From there they can save the picture, print it as a coloring page and color it in, or make a mandala to send back. The design and the words travel inside the link, so nothing is stored on our side.

    For classrooms and groups

    On a kindness day, have each person make a mandala for someone else in the group, then print them as coloring pages and swap. The words print in the middle, and the rings around them are ready to color.

    Questions

    Who can see my message?

    Only the people you send it to. The design and the words travel inside the link itself, so Super Mandala Lab never stores them. Anyone who has the link can open it, so post it publicly only if you mean to.

    How do I send it in a text?

    On a phone, tap Share the picture and link and pick Messages: they get the picture, and a link that opens it. On a computer, use Text or Copy link, or save the picture and attach it.

    Can I post it on Instagram?

    Yes. Choose Story under Send it, save the picture and post it from your phone. Or tap Share on your phone and pick Instagram.

    Do they need an account to open it?

    No. The link opens the mandala in any web browser, where they can save it, print it to color in, or make one back. There is nothing to sign up for.

    Can I print it as a card?

    Yes. Under Other formats, download a PDF at Letter or A4 to print and fold, or a round sticker for an envelope or a gift.

    Can I write a longer message?

    The middle takes two lines of up to 30 characters each, sized to fit. Two short lines read best on a phone. For more, write it in the text or the post, and let the mandala carry the short version.
